Item 5.02     Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.
On November 22, 2026, Life360, Inc. (the “Company”) and Chris Hulls, co-founder and Executive Chairman of the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of the Company, agreed that Mr. Hulls will retire as Executive Chairman, effective December 31, 2026 (the “Transition Date”). Mr. Hulls will continue to serve as a Class III director, with a term scheduled to expire at the Company’s 2028 annual meeting of stockholders. Beginning January 1, 2027, Mr. Hulls will serve as an employee of the Company in a non-executive role as Co-Founder and Senior Adviser, reporting to the Chair of the Board. Mr. Hulls will continue in his role with Company’s AI Labs efforts and perform such other duties as the Chair of the Board may direct.
On November 22, 2026, the Board appointed Mark Goines, the Company’s Lead Independent Director, as Chair of the Board, effective as of the Transition Date.
On November 22, 2026, the Company and Mr. Hulls entered into a transition and general release agreement (the “Transition Agreement”) pursuant to which Mr. Hulls will continue to receive his current base salary through the Transition Date and will remain eligible for his 2026 annual bonus, based on actual performance during 2026. For his service as Co-Founder and Senior Advisor, Mr. Hulls will receive an annual base salary of $515,000 and will have a 2027 annual bonus opportunity equal to 75% of his base salary, with payout subject to the achievement of performance goals established by the Chair of the Board and related to his new role. While employed by the Company, Mr. Hulls will not participate in the Company’s non-employee director compensation program and will not receive additional equity grants or participate in the annual bonus program after 2027. In accordance with the terms of the Company’s equity plan, Mr. Hulls will continue to vest in his outstanding equity awards based on his continued service as Co-Founder and Senior Advisor.
Under the terms of the Transition Agreement, if the Company terminates Mr. Hulls’ employment without cause or he resigns for good reason, in either case (x) prior to December 31, 2027, then the Company will continue to pay him the remaining 2027 base salary through December 31, 2027; and (y) prior to June 30, 2028, then (i) Mr. Hulls will remain eligible to receive a 2027 cash bonus (if then unpaid), determined based on actual performance, (ii) any equity awards scheduled to vest between Mr. Hulls’ separation date and June 30, 2028 (including due to the achievement of performance-based vesting conditions within such period) will vest on each applicable date provided that Mr. Hulls remains in compliance with his restrictive covenants on such date, and (iii) Mr. Hulls’ existing options will remain exercisable until their original stated expiration dates.
The Transition Agreement includes a release of claims and cooperation and non-disparagement provisions. In connection with the Transition Agreement, Mr. Hulls has also entered into a standstill agreement with the Company.
